verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own docs say it "ships an MCP server of its own". The server gives an agent host access to collections, requests, environments, and teams, lets the agent read and change them, and sends real HTTP requests; a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. missing for 10: setup, transport and authentication details in the evidence, a tool-level reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
